tier_rules.A: FDR<0.05; abs(rg)>=0.15; both h2 pass; clean analysis status; >=500000 valid-overlap SNPs; Strong/Moderate APPARENTLY_NOVEL or NO_DIRECT_RG_FOUND pair
tier_rules.B: Tier A plus independent replication or strong local support
tier_rules.C: all other tested pairs, including nominal/suggestive, QC-sensitive, or novelty-ambiguous pairs
